messages.subject: Some new issue with blavaan
parts:
Hi all,

I've installed blavaan 0.4-1 and when I try to load it, I receive the message,

Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘blavaan’ in loadNamespace(i, c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[i]]):
 there is no package called ‘colorspace’

Not sure where this is coming from or how to deal with it.

Thanks

David

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: Some new issue with blavaan
parts:
Hi David,

This can happen when one package gets updated and another doesn't, and the updated package requires a newer version of the un-updated package. Sometimes there is an option to update all packages and their dependencies at once. Otherwise, try

install.packages("colorspace")

Ed
